parameters.name: AccessType
parameters.description:
The access type. Valid values:

- **NS**: NS-based access.

- **CNAME**: CNAME-based access.

parameters.name: Coverage
parameters.description:
The acceleration region. Valid values:
- **domestic**: the Chinese mainland only.
- **global**: global.
- **overseas**: global (excluding the Chinese mainland).

parameters.name: OnlyEnterprise
parameters.description: Specifies whether to query only Enterprise Edition sites. Set this parameter to **true** to query only Enterprise Edition sites.

parameters.name: OrderBy
parameters.description:
The sort field. By default, results are sorted by creation time. Valid values:
- gmtCreate: site creation time.
- visitTime: site access time.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number for paging. The value must be greater than or equal to 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for paging. Valid values: 1 to 500.

parameters.name: PlanSubscribeType
parameters.description:
The plan subscription type. Valid values:
- **basicplan**: Basic Edition.
- **standardplan**: Standard Edition.
- **advancedplan**: Premium Edition.
- **enterpriseplan**: Enterprise Edition.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID. Used as a filter condition for the query.

parameters.name: SiteName
parameters.description: The site name. Used as a filter condition for the query.

parameters.name: SiteSearchType
parameters.description:
The search matching mode for the site name. Default is exact match. Valid values:

- **prefix**: prefix match.
- **suffix**: suffix match.
- **exact**: exact match.
- **fuzzy**: fuzzy match.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The site status. Used as a filter condition for the query.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key. Used as a filter condition for the query.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value. Used as a filter condition for the query.
